method: One frame per second, 0–4559 seconds inclusive. All 4,560 sampled frames visually reviewed in timestamped contact sheets (18 frames per sheet).
finding: The opening 0–53 seconds is a Stream starting soon card. From 54–4559 seconds, the stream shows Mario Kart Tour multiplayer cup races, including 3DS Daisy Hills R, SNES Rainbow Road T, and London Loop R. Finish pages, Actions Performed breakdowns, and This Week’s Ranking menus show points and positions, not Time Trial records. No identifiable TT record, lap split, or WR contender time. No record imported.
limitations: One-second sampling does not certify every displayed frame or audio.
The remaining 4560–8292 seconds has been indexed into contact sheets but not yet visually reviewed.
